audit.whatIsWrong: content.late states 'his R is a 100-second cooldown at rank 1, shorter as he levels it'. That number is wrong.
audit.why: Hijack is 80/55/30. A player told to wait out 100 seconds will hold Demonic Ascension for a window that closed 20 seconds earlier, and by rank 3 the real figure is 30 — less than a third of what the page claims. This is the single most consequential number in the matchup because the whole late-game plan is built on timing his steal.
audit.corrected: Hijack is 80 seconds at rank 1, falling to 30 at rank 3.

audit.whatIsWrong: Abscond / Abduct is called 'His dash + stun (recast pull)' in three fields, and wants.foe[2] says 'Chain his E stun into W drain'.
audit.why: Riot's text for the ability is 'Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits' — a 400-range dash whose recast pulls HIM to YOU, on a 13s rank-1 cooldown. The kit carries dash and projectile flags and no hardCC flag. I have not written that it does not stun, because Riot's text is silent on that and silence means unknown, not no — but the page should describe the movement and the cooldown, which are the parts that actually govern when your root lands.
audit.corrected: 400-range dash, recast chains him onto you, down 13s at rank 1 — that is the window your Nevermove needs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Kingslayer's healing is never named as a reason for anti-heal, and Hijack's range is never given.
audit.why: The _missing-interactions entry for this matchup is 'Sylas sustains through chip damage (Kingslayer (W)) — Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades', and Kingslayer's own text is explicit that it heals him against champions on a cooldown that falls to 6s. Separately Hijack is 950 range against Nevermove's 850 — he can steal Demonic Ascension from 100 units outside your root, which is precisely why 'root him first' does not protect the ultimate.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds before you drain; and Hijack outranges your root by 100, so the R decision has to be made before he is ever in Nevermove range.

edits.before: Late game, Swain's raw drain-tank ceiling is high but Sylas's carry threat at 8.5/10 means one good R steal in a teamfight flips the fight's geometry entirely. Avoid activating Demonic Ascension when Sylas has his R available and is in range — either pop it when he is clearly burned (his R is a 100-second cooldown at rank 1, shorter as he levels it), or deny him the steal opportunity by holding R until he commits his own E chain into your team first. Your W eye on chokepoints during objective fights is where you collect free fragments without giving him a clean R window; keep converting those leads to global pressure before the game reaches a state where his stolen ults decide teamfights.

notes: The wrong Hijack cooldown in content.late (100s claimed, 80/55/30 actual) is the most damaging error found in this matchup — the entire late-game plan is built on waiting it out. No mirror audit exists for sylas__swain yet; whoever runs Sylas should take the Hijack-range framing (950 vs 850) from this file rather than re-deriving it. I described Abscond / Abduct by its dash and chain-pull rather than asserting it does or does not stun: Riot's text does not mention CC and the kit carries no hardCC flag, but the brief is clear that absence from the text means unknown, so the page no longer calls it a stun and does not claim it is not one.
